label: PowerEdge R650 1U rack server
description: 1U two-socket rack server with two embedded 1GbE LOM ports, an OCP 3.0 slot on x8 PCIe lanes and a dedicated 1GbE iDRAC9 port. Up to three PCIe Gen4 low-profile slots carry stand-up adapters.
notes: Onboard: 2x 1GbE LOM. OCP 3.0 (x8 lanes) is the slot for a 10/25GbE mezzanine NIC; 3x PCIe Gen4 LP (or 2x full-height) for stand-up cards. Dedicated iDRAC port is 1GbE and separate from the data plane.
